pricing.a: No. Every plan includes guided onboarding — connecting your integrations, mapping your control owners and importing existing policies. Most teams are collecting evidence within a week.

pricing.q: What counts as an employee for billing?
pricing.a: Anyone in scope for your security programme: full-time staff and contractors with access to production systems. Auditors, advisors and read-only board members are free.

pricing.q: Can we add a framework mid-term?
pricing.a: Yes. Frameworks are added pro rata for the remainder of your term, and any control you already satisfy is credited immediately rather than restarted.

pricing.q: Do you resell the audit itself?
pricing.a: No, and deliberately so. You choose your own auditor. We keep a list of firms our customers rate well, but we take no fee for the introduction — an audit is worth more when the platform vendor isn't paying for the opinion.

pricing.q: What happens to our evidence if we leave?
pricing.a: You can export the full evidence archive and control history as a signed ZIP at any point during the contract and for 90 days after it ends. No exit fee.

pricing.q: Do you offer a discount for early-stage companies?
pricing.a: Companies under 20 people that have raised less than £3m get 40% off the Start plan for the first year. Ask on the contact form and we will apply it to your quote.

product.q: How long does it take to connect our stack?
product.a: Cloud and identity integrations are OAuth or role-based and take minutes. A typical team has AWS, GitHub and Okta connected in a single afternoon session.

product.q: Does Meridian need write access to our infrastructure?
product.a: No. Every standard integration is read-only, scoped to configuration metadata. We never request access to customer data, object storage contents or source code.

product.q: Can we write our own controls?
product.a: Yes. Custom controls accept any HTTPS endpoint or scheduled job that returns a pass/fail with evidence, so anything you can query, you can monitor.

product.q: Will our auditor accept automated evidence?
product.a: It is now the norm. Evidence carries a timestamp, the source system, the query used and a tamper-evident hash, which is a stronger artefact than a manual screenshot.
